5. Answer.

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")
ad = df[df['date']=='10/13/25']
# baseline: preceding normal weekdays (exclude weekends: Sat/Sun). 10/6(Mon)-10/10(Fri)
base_days = ['10/6/25','10/7/25','10/8/25','10/9/25','10/10/25']
bd = df[df['date'].isin(base_days)]
tot_ad = ad['unblended_cost'].sum()
tot_base = bd['unblended_cost'].sum()/5
print(f"Anomaly date total: {tot_ad:.2f}, baseline avg/day: {tot_base:.2f}, delta: {tot_ad-tot_base:.2f}")
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    g = pd.DataFrame({
        'ad': ad.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum(),
        'base': bd.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()/5
    }).fillna(0)
    g['delta'] = g['ad']-g['base']
    g = g[abs(g['delta'])>1].sort_values('delta', key=abs, ascending=False)
    print(f"\n=== {col} (sum delta {g['delta'].sum():.2f}) ===")
    print(g.head(15).round(2))
